claims.claim: Amazon maintains a GitHub organization at github.com/amzn that lists its open-source repositories.
The Amazon GitHub organization hosts a repository whose description is "Code samples and supplements for the Amazon Ads advanced tools center".
claims.quote: Code samples and supplements for the Amazon Ads advanced tools center

claims.claim: The amzn/selling-partner-api-docs repository contains documentation for developers to use to call Selling Partner APIs.
claims.quote: This repository contains documentation for developers to use to call Selling Partner APIs.

claims.claim: The amzn/selling-partner-api-models repository contains OpenAPI models for developers to use when developing software to call Selling Partner APIs.
claims.quote: This repository contains OpenAPI models for developers to use when developing software to call Selling Partner APIs.
